title: Iceland · Golden Circle and Thingvellir
slogan: A 209 km loop out of Þingvellir
story: Volcanic scale, weather discipline and big horizons. The stops in between: Geysir area, Gullfoss and Laugarvatn. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.

sections.advice: Reykjavik start → Þingvellir is the reward section in Reykjavik. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

This Geysir area → Gullfoss stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Gullfoss → Laugarvatn food is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Golden Circle
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Golden Circle, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
